rules: Universe: only strong_buy / buy names from the latest screen.
Timing filter: names with timing_signal=wait are excluded from new buys.
Sector cap: at most 1 name(s) per known sector (cap=20%).
Ranking: highest conviction_score first, keep at most 4 names.
Sizing: equal-weight sleeves of current NAV after exits; buys limited by remaining cash.
Hold buffer: full exit only after 2 consecutive rebalance(s) outside the target set.
Re-entry cooldown: wait 1 rebalance(s) after a full exit before buying the same name again.
Dust guard: skip trim/top-up adjustments below £10.
plan.summary: Next rebalance would target 4 equal-weight sleeve(s); deploy cash into 4 buy(s).
